notes: Goblin Firebomb: 'Flash' and '{7}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Destroy target permanent.' Cast on the opponent's turn (flash; a non-flash artifact would be an illegal cast), then activated at once on that turn (no timing restriction; an artifact has no summoning sickness): it is sacrificed, the target is destroyed, and exactly {1}+{7} is spent. Re-pinned 2026-10-30 (V2 + B-90 (a), at the cards/integration merge): mana empties as each step and phase ends (CR 500.5), so the mana is added at the step that spends it, standing in for the lands tapped there.
